description: Stop the running container named 'test-web-server'. You can use Docker Desktop's GUI (click 'Containers' in the left sidebar, find the 'test-web-server' row, click the square Stop button in the Actions column) or the terminal. Note: The task requires stopping the container, not removing/deleting it. If any dialogs appear, dismiss them. The task is complete when the container status shows 'Exited' (gray indicator) in Docker Desktop.
